Sobre a vaga

About The Product

At Boldin, we believe financial confidence should be accessible to everyone. Money decisions shape our lives, yet too often people are left without the clarity or tools they need to make informed choices. We exist to change that. Boldin is a comprehensive financial planning platform that helps people understand their financial picture, make smarter decisions with their money and time, and plan for the future with confidence.

With over $20M raised and strong momentum, Boldin is entering a pivotal phase of growth. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team and help shape the future.

About This Role

The Principal Data Engineer is a senior technical authority responsible for defining Boldin’s data architecture, setting long-term technical strategy, and tackling our most complex data engineering challenges. This role shapes company-wide data standards, and partners with executive and cross-functional leaders to ensure our data platform scales with the business.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and evolve long-term data architecture and vision
  • Design resilient and scalable data platform and pipelines
  • Set standards for data modeling, reliability, observability, and governance
  • Lead complex, high-risk technical initiatives and migrations
  • Influence tool selection, and technology adoption across the data stack
  • Elevate engineering excellence
  • Partner with leadership to align data strategy and business goals
  • Enable analytics, ML, and product use cases 1KPIS + Targets
  • Uptime: Consistently meets SLA for business-critical pipelines
  • Freshness: All Tier 1 datasets delivered within SLA
  • Delivery predictability: Majority of sprint commitments completed as planned
  • Cost optimization: Year-over-year efficiency improvement as data scales
  • Documentation: Full coverage for all production-grade assets

Qualifications

Technical Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering or related disciplines
  • Proficient in SQL, Python, or related languages
  • Cloud Platforms (AWS, GCP)
  • Strong experience with data warehouse, data lakes, and distributed systems
  • Strong experience with modern data stack (Athena, BigQuery, Glue, Spark, Dataproc, Kafka, Flink, dbt, Kestra, Fivetran or equivalent)
  • Proven ability to build and maintain production-grade ELT/ETL pipelines
  • Experience with workflow orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Cloud Composer)
  • Experience implementing data quality and observability frameworks
  • Performance and cost optimization in cloud warehouses
  • Good spoken English

Product & Business Partnership:

  • Experience supporting product analytics and experimentation
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable data models
  • Strong ownership and accountability for SLAs

Nice to Have:

  • Experience working with Kubernetes
  • Experience structuring data for ML or AI use cases
  • Familiarity with Amplitude or product event pipelines
  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or fintech environment
  • Influencing technical direction without direct managerial authority

Benefits:

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

As the leading offshore staffing firm in the U.S. and Europe, TurnKey helps startups and high growth tech companies hire top quality offshore software developers without giving up control of the team or the product development process. Unlike most firms in our space, we very intentionally do not do outsourcing or managed services, which usually results in low performance and high churn. Instead, TurnKey's unique staffing model combines custom tech recruiting in Eastern Europe & Latin America (where we get clients the Top 3% of engineering talent that is perfectly aligned to their needs) with no-hassle Employer of Record services (where we deal with all the legal, payroll and administrative headaches of employing and paying offshore developers so clients don't have to). Each software developer is fully integrated within the client's existing development team and company culture so clients always have complete control over when and how their developers work and what they are working on. And with TurnKey's hyper transparent pricing, clients also have control over how much their developers get paid too. Moreover, TurnKey is based in Silicon Valley so clients always have someone local to call at a moment’s notice. No more waiting weeks for an offshore vendor to call you back. Reach out today and we’ll show you how TurnKey makes staffing offshore software development teams super easy and spectacularly effective: info@turnkeystaffing.com or 310-699-6884. And you can always learn more at www.turnkeystaffing.com. We can't wait to show you the TurnKey difference!

Compromissos

Crescimento profissional e aprendizagem

For top software developers, it’s not just about earning a paycheck but rather a way of advancing skills and expertise. That’s why we’re committed to ensuring that they have the tools and opportunities to flourish. From mentoring programs to challenging projects, we give developers everything they need to take that next big step, including:

Sustentabilidade ambiental

Let’s face it, Mother Nature needs all the love she can get these days! So, you guessed it, “reduce, reuse, recycle” is exactly what we’re committed to doing here at TurnKey. Our dedication to environmental sustainability is no joke – we’re serious about making a difference. Here’s a few of the things we are doing: - Welfare webinars (these webinars are jam-packed with awesome info and tools to help us become more mindful of our impact on the planet). - Going paperless (we implemented an online document flow system that saves us from drowning in paper and leaves more trees standing). - Sustainable merchandise (we provide ecological branded merch for our team, and the online shop has items that are not only cool but also give employees the opportunity to choose products that align with their personal values).

Equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal

- Remote-first approach We’re all about giving our senior software developers the flexibility to live their best lives while they perfect their craft. - Flex time off We promote flex time off to allow senior software developers to take time off whenever they need it without worrying. - Wellbeing club We’ve coordinated a team of professional psychologists and life coaches to offer personal consultations for TurnKey’s employees to help manage stress and maintain a healthy work-life balance. - Necessities reimbursement We pick up the tab on a range of necessities that just make life better. This includes things from offering health insurance to a sports budget for our employees (up to $900 per year, mind you). - Welfare activities This is all about healthy diets, psychological help, self-love events, and stress reduction meetings! Working with software developers, we know all too well the stress that comes with tech jobs. - Wealth club Finally, we offer a financial literacy meetup held by senior TurnKey staff This club can help software developers manage their finances better and plan for the future.
